annotation_author: AI assistant visual review of decoded RGB frames
definition: First visible sustained transition from standing/walking/sitting support into the downward falling movement, not floor impact or model alert time.
limitations: Approximate visual labels on low-resolution acted clips. Prior model outputs were already known: this is not blinded annotation. Intervals are visual ambiguity brackets, not statistical confidence intervals. Labels must be independently reviewed before formal claims.
